title: half2-packed lanes feeding a modeled mixed-precision dot product (CUDA)
info: one warp (32 threads), n=64, quantization modeled as rounding to the nearest multiple of 1/256 (no real fp16/half2 type in this language subset)
tolerance 0.02 accounts for expected quantization error (~0.003 for the reference); this is precision loss, not a correctness bug
